container_runtime.note: Pinned by digest here, not just by mutable filename/tag, per this task's requirement -- the .sif itself is not yet distributed as an OCI image with a registry digest in this deployment, so the digest recorded is this file's own sha256 at validation time; re-verify this hash before trusting a future run against the same path.

foundry.note: Foundry TOOL-version provisioning (distinct from Solidity COMPILER-version provisioning, which this work's Phase 1-3 fully covers) was not extended in this pass -- see the accompanying report's 'known remaining gaps' section.

node_version: not directly queryable on the host (routed through bin/npx inside the same Singularity image as forge)

relevant_environment_variables.BENCHMARK_TOOLCHAIN_DIR: immutable, checksum-verified, shared across runs, default .benchmark/toolchains
relevant_environment_variables.BENCHMARK_REGISTRY_PATH: path to benchmark_registry.jsonl for this run
relevant_environment_variables.BENCHMARK_SOLC_DISCOVERY_HINT: optional legacy hint file, superseded by scripts.benchmark.compiler_resolver
relevant_environment_variables.BENCHMARK_STRICT_OFFLINE: 1 to hard-fail (TOOLCHAIN_NOT_PROVISIONED) instead of falling back to forge/svm auto-detection when no explicit compiler was resolved
relevant_environment_variables.BENCHMARK_SOLC_PATH: set per-compile-invocation by compile_generic() from the provisioned toolchain-lock; consumed by bin/forge
relevant_environment_variables.FORGE_FORCE_SOLC: legacy fallback, still consulted by bin/forge only when BENCHMARK_SOLC_PATH is unset
relevant_environment_variables.FORGE_VERSION: selects a pinned Foundry TOOL build under .venv/.foundry-versions/<version>/bin/forge
